mechanism: Methylphenidate increases cardiovascular stimulation and can elevate blood pressure, while triamcinolone (corticosteroid) also increases blood pressure and fluid retention, creating additive hypertensive effects; additionally, corticosteroids may increase risk of CNS stimulant-related adverse effects.
action: Monitor blood pressure regularly during concurrent use; consider alternative corticosteroid or methylphenidate adjustment if hypertension develops; assess for increased CNS stimulation symptoms.
